clusters.name: spike-gate
clusters.executionModeRationale: Phase-0 GO/NO-GO gate: must complete and return GO before any build story starts; nothing runs in parallel with the gate.

clusters.name: wire-seam
clusters.executionModeRationale: Foundational WireApi::ChatCompletions type change that other stories reference; lands alone before the parallel phase.

clusters.name: model-surface
clusters.executionModeRationale: Filter relaxation + protocol-local route hint + cache + guardrail; disjoint SOURCE files from the overlay crate so it can run in parallel with overlay-transport, but it rebases onto the Cargo.lock owned by overlay-transport this phase to avoid a lockfile conflict.

clusters.name: overlay-transport
clusters.executionModeRationale: Largest from-scratch translation code (yields NEUTRAL events, no codex-api dep to avoid a cycle); self-contained in the overlay crate. Owns the Cargo.lock / dependency edits for Phase 3 so the two parallel clusters cannot conflict on the lockfile.

clusters.name: dispatch-wiring
clusters.executionModeRationale: Integrates the WireApi variant + overlay functions into live dispatch (one client.rs arm + new core module + core->codex-copilot dep + neutral->ResponseEvent map), and flips Claude-row visibility; must follow the three upstream/overlay clusters.

clusters.name: contract-and-audit
clusters.executionModeRationale: Feature-contract gating and audit/invariant registration both edit the same docs/scripts, so serialize them together after the path works end-to-end. (Request-build hard-errors already land in US-004 so no silent path ever exists.)

clusters.name: e2e-validation
clusters.executionModeRationale: Final whole-feature verification (deterministic integration test + GPT-5.x regression + cargo check --workspace); runs last.
